front.title: Apple becomes second company to close above $5 trillion
front.tldr: Apple's share price pushed its market value above five trillion dollars at Wednesday's close, the second company ever to pass the mark after Nvidia.

front.title: HomeView is simple, and that's a good thing
front.tldr: Six Colors points to a Verge review arguing that HomeView's stripped-back design, though it may frustrate hardcore smart home users, is the right choice for Apple's new device, due in November.

front.title: OpenAI publishes 350+ proofs of mathematical theorems in one go
front.tldr: OpenAI released more than 350 proofs of mathematical theorems in a single batch, prompting mathematicians to note that doing just one by hand would normally merit a Fields Medal.

stories.title: Ricursive Intelligence is betting on AI-designed chips to help solve the compute crisis
stories.tldr: Ricursive Intelligence is building AI that designs chips and improves its own designs with each iteration, aiming to automate and speed up chip development as compute demand soars.

stories.title: Tree Appreciator
stories.tldr: Developer Simon Willison prompted Claude Opus 5.5 Max from his phone's chat app to build a three.js game about appreciating trees, his latest small vibe-coded experiment.

stories.title: Deezer will soon let you filter out AI-generated music
stories.tldr: Deezer says it will roll out a toggle letting listeners filter AI-generated tracks out of search and recommendations by the end of the year.

stories.title: Google DeepMind and Singapore government build fine-tuned AI model for scam detection
stories.tldr: Google DeepMind and Singapore's GovTech used lightweight, on-device Gemma models to intercept conversational scams in private chats without sending any data to the cloud.

stories.title: NASA explains how it's making batteries for the Moon's extreme temperatures
stories.tldr: NASA is developing new battery chemistry for lunar missions, since standard lithium-ion cells cannot handle the Moon's extreme temperature swings.

stories.title: CedarDB wants one database to handle both transactions and analytics, as AI agents raise the stakes
stories.tldr: Database startup CedarDB is building an engine that handles both transactional and analytical workloads at once, a combination it says matters more now that AI agents query data constantly.

stories.title: Colossal Biosciences announces new AI platform to help accelerate de-extinction efforts
stories.tldr: Colossal Biosciences unveiled an AI platform meant to speed up its de-extinction research, alongside a new fund from Peter Diamandis to back startups building on it.

stories.title: Sony is taking on DJI with its new ECM-W5 wireless microphone kit
stories.tldr: Sony launched the ECM-W5, a wireless microphone kit aimed squarely at DJI's audio gear, though it comes at a price.

stories.title: iPhone Duo's A20 Pro chip benchmarked ahead of launch
stories.tldr: An early Geekbench listing shows the iPhone Duo's A20 Pro chip performing similarly to the iPhone 18 Pro's, ahead of pre-orders opening this Friday.

stories.title: Apple Maps launches Detailed City Experience in Austin, Texas
stories.tldr: Apple is rolling out its more detailed Apple Maps overhaul to Austin, Texas, extending the Detailed City Experience it has already brought to other markets.

stories.title: Third-party HomeView apps? Think CarPlay
stories.tldr: HomeView ships without an App Store, but Six Colors argues its limited third-party app model works more like CarPlay's curated approach than a true app platform.

stories.title: WhatsApp takes on Zoom and Google Meet with guest calling
stories.tldr: WhatsApp now lets people join group and one-on-one calls as guests without needing an account, putting it in more direct competition with Zoom and Google Meet.

stories.title: 'To Be Ordinary' review: a compassionate, even-handed Taiwanese family melodrama
stories.tldr: Variety praises "To Be Ordinary," a Taiwanese drama about a college student left paralysed after a crash, for its sensitive, even-handed take on a hard subject.

stories.title: Harvey Keitel threw 'Bad Lieutenant' in the trash before giving one of his greatest performances
stories.tldr: Director Abel Ferrara recalls how Christopher Walken's last-minute exit nearly sank "Bad Lieutenant" in 1992, before Harvey Keitel stepped in for one of his best performances.

stories.title: Liam Neeson's stunt double of nearly 30 years steps behind the camera for 'The Mongoose'
stories.tldr: Mark Vanselow, who has doubled for Liam Neeson since 1998, draws on three decades of stunt work to direct Neeson in "The Mongoose."

stories.title: Mubi sets theatrical release for Sundance prize winning doc 'Nuisance Bear'
stories.tldr: Mubi will give "Nuisance Bear," winner of the Sundance Grand Jury documentary prize, a theatrical run starting in Los Angeles on 6 November before it expands.

stories.title: 'Whalefall' review: Austin Abrams battles a bellyful of daddy issues in brutal survival thriller
stories.tldr: IndieWire calls "Whalefall" an exceptional piece of underwater body horror, a sincere adaptation of Daniel Kraus's novel that packs real emotional weight into its survival premise.

stories.title: Celtics beat Hornets 114-93 in preseason dress rehearsal
stories.tldr: Boston beat Charlotte 114-93 to move to 3-0 in the preseason, their final tune-up before the regular season opener.

stories.title: Payton Pritchard's big contract is years in the making
stories.tldr: Four years after nearly leaving Boston out of frustration over playing time, Payton Pritchard has earned a big new contract from the Celtics.

stories.title: Drake Maye named one of two FedEx Air & Ground Players of the Week
stories.tldr: Drake Maye was named a FedEx Air & Ground Player of the Week for Week 5, sharing the honour with the Packers' Jordan Love.

stories.title: A.J. Brown returns to Patriots practice, could play as soon as Sunday
stories.tldr: A.J. Brown returned to practice five weeks after a high ankle sprain, with the Patriots opening his 21-day window to come off injured reserve for Sunday's Jets game.

stories.title: Christian Gonzalez says he's 'ready for Sunday' against Jets
stories.tldr: All-Pro cornerback Christian Gonzalez says he is ready to return this week after a shoulder injury kept him out for two games.

stories.title: Mekies signs long-term contract extension with Red Bull
stories.tldr: Red Bull extended Laurent Mekies's contract as team principal through 2031, a strong endorsement after his first season leading the team.

stories.title: Christian Horner reveals secret battle with panic attacks during F1 career
stories.tldr: In his new memoir, Christian Horner writes about the panic attacks he suffered behind the scenes during his high-pressure years leading Red Bull.

stories.title: Verstappen says Red Bull's car was "scary" to drive early in 2026
stories.tldr: Max Verstappen says Red Bull's car felt "scary" to drive early this season, before a run of upgrades turned it into a race winner.

stories.title: Durbin, Rafaela, Abreu nominated for Gold Glove Awards
stories.tldr: Red Sox players Durbin, Rafaela and Abreu are finalists for this year's Gold Glove Awards.

stories.title: Red Sox star Payton Tolle hugged his way into our hearts
stories.tldr: Over the Monster's look back at 2026 includes Payton Tolle, who won Red Sox fans over as much for his hugs as his play.

finally.title: Whoa, the Lion Nebula!
finally.tldr: NASA's James Webb Space Telescope captured a striking new image of the Lion Nebula, the glowing remnant of a massive star's supernova explosion.
